text:
**The evidence cannot establish whether the owner broke the law.** Satellite data support tree-cover loss on the property after 2020: 81.3 hectares in 2021, 0.6 hectares in 2022 and 4.5 hectares in 2023.

Most of the recorded loss was in a planted-forest context. Tree-cover loss can result from plantation harvesting or other causes; it does not by itself establish deforestation, who was responsible, or whether the activity was authorized.

Determining legality would require checking the applicable laws, permits and records of who carried out the activity.
